case: interval[] text consumers under postgres_verbose IntervalStyle
contract: A mixed-sign interval[] contains months, days, microseconds, zero interval and SQL NULL under transaction-local IntervalStyle postgres_verbose.
pg_typeof, array_to_json, canonical array text and array_send provide native type, semantic and wire-byte oracles.
Binding the driver's text as interval[] reproduces native JSON and wire bytes on the same transaction backend.
JSON, CSV and XLSX preserve the exact driver text; XLSX uses a string cell without a formula.
Replayed SQL restores native array text, JSON values and wire bytes under the same IntervalStyle; transaction rollback leaves the destination empty.

native_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract:: -- --ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL array families and IntervalStyle configurations, spreadsheet-application re-import and other native type/consumer/session combinations remain open.
